```yaml
name: Benchmark & Security Audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  # Phase A & D: Code Quality and Safety Checks
  lint-and-test:
    name: Lint, Test, and Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: clippy, rustfmt
          cache: true

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check

      - name: Run Clippy (Security Hardening Checks)
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run Unit Tests (Phase A/C/D Logic)
        run: cargo test --lib

      - name: Run Integration Tests
        run: cargo test --all

      - name: Build Release Binary
        run: cargo build --release

  # Phase B: Benchmark Accuracy Gate
  benchmark:
    name: Run Benchmark Suite
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint-and-test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build Benchmark Binary
        run: cargo build --release --bin waf-detector

      - name: Run Benchmark against Corpus
        # Assumes the binary is named waf-detector and accepts --benchmark flag
        # Phase B1: Uses benchmark_corpus.json
        # Phase B5: CI workflow with accuracy threshold gate
        run: |
          # Ensure corpus exists
          if [ ! -f "benchmark_corpus.json" ]; then
            echo "::error::benchmark_corpus.json not found. Please ensure Phase B1 artifact is present."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Run benchmark and capture output
          # The binary should exit with non-zero if accuracy thresholds are not met
          ./target/release/waf-detector --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json

      - name: Upload Benchmark Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: |
            benchmark_results.json
            benchmark_log.txt
          retention-days: 30

  # Phase D: Trust & Productization Verification
  trust-verification:
    name: Verify Trust Features
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint-and-test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build Release Binary
        run: cargo build --release --bin waf-detector

      - name: Verify Prod Mode Token Enforcement
        # Phase D3: WAF_DETECTOR_MODE=prod enforcing token auth
        run: |
          echo "Testing Prod Mode Token Enforcement..."
          # Start server in background with prod mode
          WAF_DETECTOR_MODE=prod ./target/release/waf-detector --server &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          sleep 2
          
          # Attempt request without token (should fail)
          if curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/api/v1/detect | grep -q "401"; then
            echo "PASS: Prod mode correctly rejects missing token."
          else
            echo "FAIL: Prod mode did not reject missing token."
            kill $SERVER_PID
            exit 1
          fi
          
          kill $SERVER_PID

      - name: Verify Deterministic Replay Bundle
        # Phase D2: Deterministic VaReplayBundle with MD5 integrity hash
        run: |
          echo "Testing Deterministic Replay Bundle..."
          # This test assumes a specific CLI flag or endpoint to generate a bundle
          # For CI, we might mock the input or use a fixed seed
          ./target/release/waf-detector --generate-bundle --seed 12345 --output bundle1.json
          ./target/release/waf-detector --generate-bundle --seed 12345 --output bundle2.json
          
          HASH1=$(md5sum bundle1.json | awk '{print $1}')
          HASH2=$(md5sum bundle2.json | awk '{print $1}')
          
          if [ "$HASH1" = "$HASH2" ]; then
            echo "PASS: Replay bundles are deterministic."
          else
            echo "FAIL: Replay bundles differ for same seed."
            exit 1
          fi
```
